project.title: Pilot Launch of a Customer-Centric Seasonal Promotion Corner
project.objective: Design and run a 4-week in-store seasonal promotion corner that boosts sales and improves customer experience while standardising basic retail routines.
deliverables: Standard layout and merchandising plan for the seasonal promotion corner
Daily operating checklist for promotion area and stock control
Customer interaction and upselling script for sales assistants
Simple sales and stock tracking sheet for the promotion period
End-of-pilot summary report with sales, issues, and improvement ideas
constraints: Pilot must be prepared and launched within 14 days
Use only existing store fixtures and low-cost printed materials
Follow company pricing and discount policies strictly
No changes to POS system; use existing invoice and refund flows
Promotion corner must be operable with current staffing levels

risks.risk: Promotion corner causes stock-outs of regular items.
risks.mitigation: Set minimum stock thresholds and daily stock check routine for promoted items.

risks.risk: Sales assistants do not follow the new upselling script consistently.
risks.mitigation: Create a short, clear script and run a quick role-play session before launch.

risks.risk: Layout blocks customer flow or creates clutter.
risks.mitigation: Test layout during low-traffic hours and adjust based on walk-through feedback.

risks.risk: Manual tracking sheet is filled inconsistently or late.
risks.mitigation: Assign clear owner per shift and include tracking in daily checklist.

themes.why_relevant: The team must agree how to organise and present products in the promotion corner.
Sales assistants need a shared approach to guiding customers and suggesting add-ons.
Avoiding stock-outs and overstock is key to a smooth promotion pilot.
Standard routines help keep the corner tidy, compliant, and easy to run each shift.
Simple tracking lets the team see what works and adjust during the pilot.

backlog.task: Define product selection and quantities for the seasonal promotion corner
definition_of_done: List of promoted products agreed with store manager
Initial quantities per product defined based on past sales and stock
List shared in channel and saved in tracking sheet

backlog.task: Design standard layout and product display for the promotion corner
definition_of_done: Sketch or photo-based layout created for shelves and table
Product grouping and facing rules documented
Layout approved by store manager and shared with team

backlog.task: Create daily promotion corner operating checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist covers opening, mid-shift, and closing tasks
Includes stock check, tidiness, price labels, and tracking update
Checklist tested for 2 days and adjusted based on feedback

backlog.task: Draft customer interaction and upselling script
definition_of_done: Short script with greeting, needs questions, and add-on suggestions written
At least two colleagues review and comment
Final version printed or made easily accessible at the counter

backlog.task: Set up simple sales and stock tracking sheet for promoted items
definition_of_done: Sheet includes date, product, units sold, units remaining, notes
Shift responsibilities for filling the sheet are defined
Test entries done and validated for clarity

backlog.task: Prepare physical promotion corner (cleaning, signage, initial setup)
definition_of_done: Area cleaned and cleared of unrelated items
Signage printed or written and placed visibly
Initial stock arranged according to layout plan

backlog.task: Align with administrative assistant on invoice and refund handling for promotion items
definition_of_done: Confirm correct product codes and prices for all promoted items
Clarify how to handle refunds and exchanges during promotion
Summary of rules posted in channel for reference

backlog.task: Run quick role-play session to practice the upselling script
definition_of_done: At least three team members practice typical customer scenarios
Feedback collected and minor script tweaks agreed
Key tips captured and added to the script document

backlog.task: Monitor promotion performance and issues during first week
definition_of_done: Daily notes on sales trends and customer reactions captured
Any recurring issues (stock, layout, questions) listed
Short mid-pilot update shared in channel

backlog.task: Adjust product mix and layout based on first-week results
definition_of_done: Decisions on adding/removing products documented
Layout changes tested and photographed
Updated plan shared with all shifts
Key numbers from tracking sheet summarised
What worked well and what to improve listed
Recommendations for next seasonal promotion documented

backlog.task: Document supplier feedback and replenishment learnings
definition_of_done: Notes on delivery times and stock reliability recorded
Suggestions for future order quantities captured
Summary shared with store manager and admin support

artifacts.used_for: Captures results, issues, and recommendations after the pilot ends.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on product selection and initial layout for the promotion corner
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the seasonal promotion pilot and asking for product and layout ideas.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final list of products to include in the promotion corner.
Approve the initial layout plan and photo example for the corner.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define daily routines, checklist, and responsibilities per shift
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing a draft of the daily operating checklist and asking for gaps or overlaps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the daily promotion corner checklist.
Assign who is responsible for completing the checklist on each shift.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on customer interaction script and quick training approach
threads_plan.trigger: Post with the first draft of the upselling script and request for feedback before role-play.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the final version of the customer interaction and upselling script.
Agree on a time window for a short role-play practice session.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Clarify invoicing, pricing, and refund handling for promotion items
threads_plan.trigger: Question from a team member about how to process a refund for a promoted product.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the standard process for invoicing and refunds for all promotion items.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review first-week results and adjust product mix and layout
threads_plan.trigger: Post sharing early numbers from the tracking sheet and asking for observations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which products or layout elements to change for the second half of the pilot.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on promotion corner status at end of each shift
Weekly mini-review of sales and customer feedback in the channel
Photo update ritual when making any visible change to the promotion layout
Quick end-of-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned
